_comment: Where the files too big for the site live: OP-XY's screen sprites (built by scripts/opxy-assets.mjs) and Minty's audio renders (built by scripts/minty-data.mjs). `host` is the asset host's root URL; `projects` gives each project's folder under it. A project can instead be a full URL, for one hosted somewhere else. Every value ends with a slash. Until the real host is set, OP-XY's pages fall back to alt text and Minty's player says its audio isn't reachable. The host must support HTTP range requests, or audio can't seek.
